knownLimitations: Only hardware v5 and exact release 23.05.5 are covered. Different stock firmware, releases and revisions are not equivalent.
Historical release reference only; profile does not recommend installing firmware.
Live DNS packages, IPv6 LAN behavior, driver client-limit enforcement, persistence and all cellular/USSD pathways require further verification.

evidenceSources.summary: Exact v5 target, wireless hardware and no integrated modem are documented.
Exact OpenWrt 23.05.5 target. Historical compatibility reference, not an installation or upgrade recommendation.

Documents dnsmasq and odhcpd roles; installed packages and active services must still be verified.
